/* Summary: Updates FLuxSequenceRecorderObject recorded time from encoded byte count.
   
   Source: SoulcaliburVI.exe static analysis at 0x14089F9D0; default recorder-object vtable helper.
   
   Parameters:
   pRecorderObject - recorder object with nEncodedSize at +0x10 and nRecordedTime at +0x18.
   
   Returns:
   void.
   
   Algorithm:
   1. Divide nEncodedSize by four, using the signed-rounding sequence emitted by MSVC.
   2. Store the result in nRecordedTime.
   
   Replay pipeline relevance:
   For the default input recorder object, one recorded-time unit corresponds to four encoded bytes
   when this helper is invoked. */

void UpdateLuxSequenceRecorderObjectRecordedTimeFromByteCount
               (FLuxSequenceRecorderObject *pRecorderObject)

{
  pRecorderObject->nRecordedTime =
       (int)(pRecorderObject->nEncodedSize + (pRecorderObject->nEncodedSize >> 0x1f & 3U)) >> 2;
  return;
}
